An '''engineer''' who had formerly worked for [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] was contracted by the [[Saurton]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Miktiss]] to modify his [[Action IV transport]] ''[[Asagov Raider]]'' during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The engineer's assistance was acquired through the use of blackmail and bargaining.
